dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Rapid linear reduction in lateral width from the superior to the inferior frame margins, indicating significant narrowing toward the posterior.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: The visible left lateral margin is smooth and linear; the right margin is obscured by shadow and water turbidity.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white skin tone with high median pixel intensity.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, vertical, high-contrast dark linear mark is present on the right-hand side of the dorsal plane.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A deep, shadow-casting longitudinal crease or furrow is visible along the right side of the central dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical linear indentation or scar is visible on the dorsal surface.
